subject.title: fix(codex): keep OpenClaw exec when native surface has no environment (#92238)

question: Should OpenClaw restore its own `exec` and `process` tools for Codex app-server direct/no-sandbox turns when Codex has no execution environment?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it deliberately changes the shell-execution boundary for Codex app-server runs.

options.title: Accept Direct Shell Restore
options.body: Accept the focused restore for direct/no-sandbox Codex runs and merge after normal exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Require Hosted Cron Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted real OpenAI OAuth cron run before merge if bridge-level local process proof is not enough for this boundary.

options.title: Pause For Policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a different permanent shell ownership policy for Codex app-server direct runs.

recommendation.title: Accept Direct Shell Restore
recommendation.body: Accept the focused restore for direct/no-sandbox Codex runs and merge after normal exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent Codex native execution and sandbox-boundary work is closest to the shell-execution policy choice this PR requires.
